reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment — consistent with a no-action, internal-evidence finding.

The cited text supports compliance with MINCOMMIT: the funding commitment runs from SFJ to PB (a commitment made to our side, expressly excluded by the detection guidance), and PB's Article 6 Approval Payments are contingent on Regulatory Approval and scaled to actual Development Costs funded, with express 'true-up payments' rather than a shortfall penalty.

No take-or-pay, minimum purchase, shortfall charge or volume cap on our usage appears in the cited clauses; PB also holds exits (Section 6.7.1 buy-out and Section 14.2.2 at-will termination), so the walk-away scenario is not present.

Sub-elements that fall short of ideal (the $110M floor on the Elected Total Amount, the matched-spend use-of-proceeds covenant, and the 300% at-will exit payment) are correctly noted in the rationale rather than flagged, and the exit economics are properly deferred to the termination rule to avoid double-flagging the same commercial term.
